normalized_decision: A cross-context import to a non-public layer is a bounded-context breach even when the ordinary layer rule permits that dependency; contexts.json declares public API surface per context; detection runs on arch.Graph edges; different declared contexts, target layer not public in target context -> violation; uncontexted/same-context edges do not trigger this rule
authority_evidence: Implemented in ContextSet.Detect(); invoked by cmd/archlint runMetrics() line 252; README 174-177 documents as bounded-context boundary concept orthogonal to layer rules; example in examples/metrics-sample/
candidate_rule: ContextViolation: e.From in ctxA, e.To in ctxB, ctxA≠ctxB, e.To ∉ publicOf[ctxB]
human_notes: Bounded-context enforcement can reject an edge that ordinary layer rules permit; frozen v0.1 has no approved relationship type representing this interaction
